scope: Pure mathematical/source audit plus SHA and report-state inspection; not an independent reproduction of 935 residual boxes or of directed arithmetic output.

checks.statement: N.6: positive modewise exponential kernels are bounded before radial sup and Fourier sum; the source gain 1/M is not assigned to point sources.
N.8: physical B is transformed by i sign(m) only on nonzero modes; the physical B square remains unchanged in Q; both mean equations and source units remain.
N.9-N.10: all finite Fourier convolutions precede the global Neumann remainder; gamma*T, |beta|*T/4, |beta|*T are separate and the mean is not divided by four.
N.4: finite piecewise radial algebra uses max over closed pieces with both interface traces, then Fourier l1; neither centre nor correction is falsely required continuous.
N.10b: d jump is j_b+q j_c; backward D point kernel and forward C point kernel are bounded by one; D-to-C triangle remains T, giving HD*JB+(HD*qplus+HC)*JC+Jmean.

Jump source: exact binary rationals are used for coefficients, nodes and amplitude; Horner evaluates every interior join; real sine/cosine absolute coefficient sums equal the two-sided Fourier A0 norm.
N.15: distributional jumps enter with the same minus-G_vec residual sign; original equation U=Hh+G_Q Q(U) then gives radial continuity. G_vec and G_Q are distinguished.
N.13-N.16: both full DQ columns and the pair-l1 maximum are retained; the Hessian majorant uses S=Bcentre+ccentre+rho, not two independently discarded correction columns.

Regularity source: the initial full jump-corrected strict ball is rechecked; only one explicit radius 2*epsilon/(1-lambda0) is proposed and accepted only after its own true denominator/DQ/image gates.

Angular regularity: strict interior margin permits small translated boundary data around the fixed nonzero centre; Green and Q commute with translations, and fixed-point uniqueness identifies the translated solution.
Strong two angular derivatives: difference quotients and (I-G_Q DQ)^-1 precede Fourier-coordinate identification; all mean derivatives are exactly zero but their values and radial equations persist.
Actual inner derivative weights are physical 4(j+1); outer nonzero A2 budget pays both angular derivatives, and all generated unknown output frequencies remain.
The result is a four-port driven curvature BVP and local C2 immersion; nonlinear regular tail, body seam, mean height/flux and periodic Euclidean holonomy are not claimed solved.
